entities.summary: Jason Myers is an American professional football placekicker for the Seattle Seahawks of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Marist Red Foxes. Myers played for the Jacksonville Jaguars and New York Jets. He kicked five field goals in Super Bowl LX for the Seahawks, setting the record for the most field goals in a Super Bowl. Myers also scored 206 combined points in the 2025 regular season and postseason to set a new NFL record.
